comments.author: himax16
comments.content:
[Summary and rationale]

Please grant a Feature Freeze Exception to update magnum-capi-helm from
1.2.0-3 to 1.4.0-0ubuntu1 in Ubuntu 26.10 (Stonking).

magnum-capi-helm is the OpenStack Magnum driver that provisions Kubernetes
clusters via Cluster API and Helm. Stonking targets OpenStack 2026.2
Hibiscus (magnum 22.0.0 is in stonking-proposed). The version in the
archive, 1.2.0 (October 2024), is significantly older.

Upstream 1.3.0 and 1.4.0 were released on 2025-07-31 and 2026-06-09
respectively. The update was prepared as part of the Hibiscus alignment
effort but was not uploaded before Feature Freeze on 20 August.

This update also repairs the package's own autopkgtest in Stonking.
magnum-capi-helm 1.2.0-3 currently fails three unit tests
(test_get_capi_cluster_found, test_get_kubeadm_control_plane_found,
test_get_machine_deployment_found) because requests 2.34 makes
Session.get() pass params=None explicitly; 1.4.0 contains the upstream
fix ("Fix tests due to upgrade of requests 2.34+"). The failure currently
blocks the migration of pbr, oslo.log and oslo.utils.

[Requested update]

magnum-capi-helm: 1.2.0-3 -> 1.4.0

Changes since 1.2.0 (upstream ChangeLog):

1.2.1
* Fix deletion of non-default node groups
* Introduce Magnum-CAPI-helm documentation

1.3.0
* Implement control plane resize
* Use API load-balancer floating IPs according to template and label
* Support token-based kubeconfig files for the CAPI management cluster
* Fix resize of default workers via terraform

1.4.0
* Support adding multiple extra networks
* Pass network_driver template option as CNI type
* Add oslo.config-based cluster label registry with auto-generated docs
* Add support for HelmChartProxy resources
* Generalize Kubernetes control plane resource handling
* Use openstackcluster v1beta1 API
* Support the Magnum credential API (application credential rotation)
* Start using csi_cinder_volume_binding_mode config option
* Fix: allow deprecated label names to be used
* Adapt to latest Magnum changes
* Fix tests for requests >= 2.34
* Drop support for Python 3.6-3.9
* Expanded documentation

[Regression potential]

* The driver provisioning paths change behaviour: OpenStackCluster v1beta1,
  HelmChartProxy support, credential rotation and control-plane resize
  affect cluster create/update/resize flows and require a Cluster API
  management cluster with v1beta1 providers and compatible capi-helm-charts
  (the defaults are configurable via the driver's oslo.config options).
* Packaging adds six explicit runtime Depends (python3-certifi,
  python3-keystoneauth1, python3-oslo.concurrency, python3-oslo.config,
  python3-requests, python3-yaml). All are already installed transitively
  via python3-magnum, so no new packages are required.
* magnum-capi-helm has no reverse dependencies.
* Newest Hibiscus's magnum no longer depends on python-novaclient, causing
  some novaclient-mocked flavor-validation tests failures. These tests are
  skipped. The replacement openstacksdk paths in magnum are already covered
  by the test_validate_*_openstacksdk tests.
* Verification: the nit-test suite (169 tests) passes on a Stonking system
  with python3-requests 2.34.2-1 and magnum 22.0.0, including the three
  previously failing tests.

[Other info]

* Debian remains at 1.2.0-3; Ubuntu carries this update ahead of Debian.
* Test PPA / merge proposal: <link TBD>
